content.comment_body: Hello all, I want to activate the web server on my [product_name] device, but I don't want to use the [product_name] software. Is there a way to do this? When I try to connect, I see the login page, but it says the web server is disabled. I simply need to enable it. Thanks.
No, it's not possible to enable the web server without using [product_name] software.
Hi, thanks for your reply. I'll get my [product_name] software tomorrow. Do I need a USB loading cable for the initial connection, or can I use Ethernet from the start?
Using an Ethernet cable is sufficient for the first connection.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is unable to activate the web server on a [product_name] device without relying on the required [product_name] software. The web interface is accessible, but actual functionality remains inaccessible until the web server is enabled via the software. This reliance on proprietary tools for essential setup causes inconvenience and limits flexibility.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects a way to enable the web server directly, without being forced to use dedicated software. They hope for a more convenient, independent setup process.
